name: ext_auto5_main
purpose: B1 version 5 (ext auto5, round 2): tolerant_auto5 reads no stated damage; auto3's gate, then targeted opening with re-selection (ext_narrow.select_open, de-duplicated terms, opening budget max(#BH,1)) whenever the gate is open; two-sided width per (T, branch) from experiments/ext/auto5/width_table.json (D-07H development probe). tolerant_auto5_small = ablation, targeted only at T = 40. pselect_union recomputed in-run (paired with a2b_pselect).
